scientific_integrity: The analytic proof establishes the infinite-family claim. Exact-rational finite tests are supporting checks only. No authorship, external verification, or independence is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Equal-size unweighted split graphs, noise-free leaders, budget below one part size; the asymptotic law requires fixed positive sqrt-scale budget parameter. No assertion of complete prior-art exclusion or external review.
title: A square-root migration law for optimal noise-free leaders on balanced split networks
